{
  "steps": [
    {
      "type": "click",

      "timeout": 3,
      "locator_type": "xpath",

      "element_name": "登录-其他方式登录"
    },
    {
      "type": "click",
      "enabled": true,
      "timeout": 2,
      "locator_type": "xpath",

      "element_name": "登录-同意协议（同意并继续）"
    },
    {
      "type": "tap_xy",
      "enabled": true,
      "timeout": 3,
      "x": 618,
      "y": 2345,

      "locator_value": "618,2345"

      "type": "input",
      "enabled": true,
      "timeout": 3,
      "text": "13342905882",

    {
      "type": "wait",
      "enabled": true,
      "seconds": 1
    },
    {
      "type": "click",
      "enabled": true,
      "timeout": 3,
      "locator_type": "xpath",
      "locator_value": "//FrameLayout[1]/LinearLayout[1]/FrameLayout[1]/FrameLayout[1]/View[1]/View[1]/View[1]/View[1]/ImageView[3]",
      "element_name": "登录-输入密码可视化按钮"

    {
      "type": "wait",
      "enabled": true,
      "seconds": 1

    {
      "type": "click",
      "enabled": true,
      "timeout": 2,

    {
      "type": "input",
      "enabled": true,
      "timeout": 2,
      "text": "Aa123456",
      "locator_type": "xpath",

      "type": "click",
      "enabled": true,
      "timeout": 2,
